conditions.comparison_limit: OpenAI Responses API with web_search versus the Grok consumer interface. This is not a consumer ChatGPT Search comparison. Interface, collection timing and execution-path differences confound platform contrasts.
conditions.model_identity_limit: Requested and returned gpt-5.6-sol is an undated identifier. The actual backend/snapshot is not independently established; a fixed ID and medium effort do not prove a fixed backend or equivalence to consumer ChatGPT Search.
